colibrigroup-colibrigroup:lever:5fae4109.description: At Colibri, culture is a critical part of our collective success, and we live our values everyday: Love, Joy, Boldness, Teamwork and Curiosity. To learn more, please visit: www.colibrigroup.com Position Overview: The Business Operations Supervisor leads a team responsible for processing incoming continuing education test materials, payments, and related documentation, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and efficient completion of daily tasks within a controlled clean-room environment. jobgether-jobgether:lever:5657b57f-84c7-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Clinical Business Analyst – Clinical Documentation based in India. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to a major clinical information transformation focused on improving healthcare delivery through standardized digital systems. You will help shape clinical documentation practices, workflows, templates, and content within a large-scale healthcare environment. Working closely with physicians, nurses, nurse practitioners, and other clinical stakeholders, you will translate operational needs into effective digital solutions. The role combines clinical informatics expertise with business analysis, requirements gathering, process design, and implementation support. You will play an important part in enabling consistent documentation and workflows across acute-care settings. This is a collaborative opportunity for an experienced analyst who understands both clinical environments and complex EHR or CIS transformations. Support the standardization and implementation of clinical documentation practices, workflows, templates, and clinical content across a large-scale clinical information transformation. Gather and analyze requirements from physicians, nurses, nurse practitioners, clinical subject matter experts, and other healthcare stakeholders. Facilitate workshops and stakeholder discussions to identify business needs, workflow requirements, use cases, and opportunities for improvement. Conduct detailed business process analysis and translate clinical requirements into clear functional and design documentation. Develop and maintain business analysis deliverables supporting clinical documentation and inpatient medicine. Contribute to the design and implementation of clinical workflows within Clinical Information Systems, EHR, or EMR environments. Collaborate closely with clinical stakeholders, project teams, SMEs, and technology professionals to ensure solutions align with operational and clinical needs. Support the successful transition from multiple standalone hospital information systems toward standardized and integrated clinical information capabilities. Requirements University degree in Healthcare, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience. At least 5 years of experience as a Clinical Analyst, Clinical Informatics Analyst, Clinical Business Analyst, or in a comparable role. At least 5 years of experience in clinical documentation , including requirements gathering, workshop facilitation, use case analysis, business process analysis, detailed design, and business analysis documentation. At least 5 years of experience supporting large-scale acute-care digital health transformations or CIS/EHR implementations. Direct experience implementing Clinical Information Systems, Electronic Health Records, or Electronic Medical Records at a comparable scale. Demonstrated experience developing clinical deliverables that support Inpatient Medicine . Strong understanding of acute-care clinical workflows, clinical documentation practices, and healthcare operations. Strong analytical, facilitation, documentation, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to communicate effectively and collaborate with clinical professionals, SMEs, project teams, and diverse healthcare stakeholders. Comfortable working in complex transformation programs where clinical, operational, and technology requirements must be aligned. jobgether-jobgether:lever:eeaf4b93-4c33-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. You will take a holistic view of the user experience, connecting user needs with product strategy and business growth. Rather than focusing solely on interface design, you will analyze complete customer journeys, uncover friction, and identify opportunities to improve conversion and retention. You will collaborate closely with product, technology, marketing, business, design, and development teams to turn insights into meaningful product improvements. The role also provides an opportunity to influence the development of a next-generation mobile experience. It is well suited to a strategic, research-driven UX professional who enjoys solving complex problems in fast-growing digital environments. Conduct comprehensive UX and product audits to identify usability issues, friction points, gaps, and opportunities across the digital product experience. Map and evaluate the complete customer journey, from discovering an event and exploring options through ticket purchase, access, and post-event engagement. Conduct user research, interviews, usability testing, and behavioral analysis to understand user motivations, needs, pain points, and decision-making. Identify opportunities to improve navigation, event discovery, checkout experiences, conversion rates, retention, and overall product usability. Translate research and product insights into clear user flows, wireframes, product requirements, recommendations, and actionable solutions. Identify product opportunities that strengthen product-market fit and create measurable value for both users and business partners. Help adapt the product experience to different markets, cultures, languages, and user behaviors as the platform expands internationally. Work closely with product managers, UI/UX designers, developers, technology teams, marketing, and business stakeholders to ensure UX recommendations are effectively implemented. Establish UX priorities by balancing user impact, business objectives, technical considerations, and growth potential. Contribute to the UX strategy and product development of an upcoming mobile application. Establish scalable UX principles, processes, research practices, and design best practices that can support a growing product and team. Challenge assumptions, identify opportunities in ambiguous situations, and turn complex findings into clear priorities and actionable product decisions. Requirements Strong professional experience in UX strategy, user research, product design, or digital product development. Demonstrated experience improving consumer-facing digital products and navigating complex, multi-step user journeys. Strong understanding of user behavior, conversion optimization, retention, and product-led growth. Ability to connect user needs and research insights with broader business objectives and measurable growth outcomes. Experience collaborating closely with product, design, engineering, development, marketing, and other cross-functional teams. Experience supporting products through periods of growth, product-market fit, transformation, or international expansion. Strong analytical, communication, presentation, and problem-solving skills. Ability to conduct qualitative and quantitative research and translate findings into practical product recommendations. Strong product intuition and the ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on UX execution. Experience in ticketing, events, marketplaces, e-commerce, travel, entertainment, SaaS, or high-growth technology environments is a strong advantage. jobgether-jobgether:lever:f8f3a557-80c2-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Azure Data Engineer based in Italy. This role offers the opportunity to strengthen cybersecurity operations by engineering reliable, scalable security data pipelines across cloud and on-premises environments. You will work with high volumes of security telemetry and help ensure critical data is available for threat detection, incident response, compliance, and cyber risk visibility. The position combines hands-on data engineering with cybersecurity, cloud technologies, automation, and data quality management. You’ll collaborate with application, infrastructure, security, governance, and vendor teams to onboard and optimize diverse data sources. The role is well suited to an engineer who enjoys troubleshooting complex ingestion challenges and improving system reliability and efficiency. You’ll operate in a highly regulated financial services environment where data integrity, security, and operational excellence are essential. This is an opportunity to make a direct impact on the organization’s ability to detect, investigate, and respond to cyber threats. Design, build, and maintain scalable security data ingestion pipelines for SIEM and cloud data platforms, including Azure Data Explorer and Log Analytics. Parse, normalize, transform, enrich, and validate structured and unstructured security telemetry using regex, JSON parsing, schema mapping, and other data-processing techniques. Partner with application owners, infrastructure and cloud teams, vendors, security stakeholders, and other internal groups to onboard new log sources and validate end-to-end data flows. Ensure the integrity, completeness, timeliness, and quality of security telemetry used for monitoring, detection, incident response, reporting, and risk management. Align security data with established schemas, naming conventions, governance standards, and organizational requirements to support downstream analytics and automation. Troubleshoot ingestion, parsing, transformation, schema, and data-quality issues across diverse platforms and environments. Maintain clear documentation covering log onboarding procedures, source requirements, data mappings, pipeline configurations, and operational support processes. Collaborate with detection engineering and security operations teams to ensure telemetry supports investigation, threat detection, response, and cyber risk use cases. Conduct telemetry gap analyses, identify missing or incomplete data sources, and recommend priorities for improving security coverage. Support logging practices that meet regulatory, audit, compliance, retention, and data-integrity requirements. Improve ingestion frameworks, automation, and onboarding processes to increase scalability, repeatability, reliability, and cost efficiency. Support infrastructure-as-code, scripting, and automation initiatives that streamline deployment and ongoing pipeline maintenance. Monitor pipeline performance and work with stakeholders to optimize ingestion reliability, throughput, and operational costs. Stay current with emerging cybersecurity telemetry formats, logging standards, data engineering practices, and cloud security data-platform capabilities. Hands-on experience onboarding, managing, and validating log sources within SIEM, cloud data platforms, or security analytics environments. Strong understanding of data parsing, normalization, transformation, and validation, including experience with regex, JSON, XML, CSV, and both structured and unstructured data. Familiarity with security telemetry from network, endpoint, identity, application, cloud, and infrastructure environments. What you’ll do As a Research Scientist at Simular, you will: - Shape the future of agentic AI by pioneering new research directions in planning, reinforcement learning, multimodal reasoning, grounding, human-agent. interaction, and alignment (e.g. reward modeling, automated task evaluation, AI safety). - Design and execute experiments end-to-end: from data collection and benchmarking, to model training and evaluation. - Develop new methodologies that push the boundaries of AI agent capabilities and reliabilities, advancing both academic and product impacts, in collaboration with world-class scientists and engineers. - Collaborate closely with engineers to integrate research prototypes into product - Publish and present results at top-tier conferences, contributing to the broader AI research community. - Advance the science hands-on through designing methods, building datasets, running experiments, and benchmarking against state of the art. You might be a fit if - PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or related field, or equivalent research experience. - Experience owning the complete research lifestyle: leading and executing a research program from ideation all the way to publication. - Expertise in one or more of (but not limited to) the following areas: - Pre-training, post-training, or fine-tuning LLMs/VLMs - Reinforcement learning and/or LLM-based agents - Computer vision and multimodal learning - Representation learning and embeddings. - Consistent publication record as first author in leading conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR, ACL, etc.). - Strong implementation skills in modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, etc.). - Demonstrated ability to run complex experiments, analyze results, and iterate quickly. - Passion for high-impact research with real-world applications. - Ambition and vision to redefine what’s possible in AI research and deployment.

southparkcommons-sparrow:ashbyhq:0166e66.title: Senior Product Designer
southparkcommons-sparrow:ashbyhq:0166e66.description: ABOUT US Sparrow is the first high-tech, high-touch employee leave management solution. Our mission is to make it simple for companies to provide their employees with all kinds of leave (i.e. family, medical, etc.). Currently, the leave management process is painful and inefficient for everyone. Company leaders struggle to keep up with regulations and processes that change frequently, and the employees going on leave are overwhelmed by bureaucracy at an exceptionally important juncture in their career. Sparrow transforms this ordinarily tedious, error-prone, complex to remain compliant, and time-consuming process into a 30-minute end-to-end experience saving teams time (20 - 40 hours per leave) and money (up to $30K per leave). Sparrow is headquartered in San Francisco but all employees work remotely across the country. Sparrow is a diverse, highly talented, and supportive team. Together, we are hardworking, collaborative, smart, and humble—after all, we’re solving real problems. THE ROLE We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to design thoughtful, high-quality experiences across key areas of the product. You’ll drive end-to-end design processes, partner closely with Product and Engineering, and contribute to improving how Sparrow designs and ships. This is a senior IC role: you’ll take ownership of meaningful product areas, execute with a high degree of autonomy, and help elevate quality and consistency across the product. WHAT YOU’LL DO In this role you will: - Own end-to-end design for product features and workflows—from discovery to flows, UI, interaction details, and shipped outcomes. - Design for operational complexity: create experiences that handle edge cases, regulatory nuance, and real-world processes without overwhelming users. - Work across multiple personas: understand user goals and context, and design experiences that feel cohesive across different users and levels of expertise. - Partner closely with Product & Engineering to clarify problems, explore solutions, define scope, and ship high-quality work quickly. - Use research and data pragmatically: run scrappy discovery (interviews, workflow mapping, prototype tests), synthesize insights, and iterate. - Contribute to design quality and consistency: apply and help evolve design patterns and systems that enable speed and coherence. - Communicate clearly: share rationale, tradeoffs, and decisions to build alignment across the EPD team. As an early senior member of the design team, you’ll play an important role in shaping the product experience and contributing to how we build. ABOUT YOU We’re looking for a product-minded designer who stays close to customers and the details—someone who can simplify complex systems into calm, intuitive experiences. More specifically, we’re looking for people with: - 4–6+ years of product design experience (or equivalent), including shipping meaningful product work. - Experience designing complex, workflow-heavy products (bonus if operationally complex: fintech/healthcare/HR/payments/insurance/benefits/admin tools, etc.). - Strong interaction and systems thinking—able to design flows that handle nuance, permissions, states, and exceptions. - Comfort working with ambiguity and moving quickly: you can contribute to problem definition, propose options, and iterate toward strong solutions. - Strong collaboration skills with Product and Engineering, including participating in scope and tradeoff discussions. - Excellent craft and attention to detail in UI, content, and interaction patterns. - Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ultimately, most important to us is someone who is passionate about applying technology to real, difficult problems, who loves building beautiful and useful products, and who finds our mission compelling. COMPENSATION - This is a full-time, exempt position. Compensation is $156,200 at the national average, but can range from $139,018-$171,820 based on your state of residence. WHY SPARROW? Our work

summitwashholdings-summitwashholdings:le.description: IMPORTANT - REQUIRED NEXT STEP As part of our hiring process, all applicants are required to complete the Predictive Index (PI) Behavioral Assessment. The PI Behavioral Assessment is not a test, and there are no right or wrong answers. It helps us better understand your natural workplace preferences and behaviors. Please complete the assessment when prompted. Completion is required for your application to move forward in the review process. Benefits, and Perks - Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance - Flexible scheduling - Paid Time Off (PTO) - Career Growth based on Performance and not Seniority – 75% of employees were promoted within Summit Wash Holdings - Referral Bonus up to $800.00 per qualified hire, dependent on position - Free Car Wash Membership Who are we? Summit Wash Holdings is a premier group of car wash brands growing throughout the Northeast, Midwest, and Southeast regions. At Summit Wash Holdings, all teammates produce speedy service in a fun and mutually respectful manner with gold-standard integrity, quality, and hospitality, all while maintaining a work-life balance. Our Mission is to provide a fast, quality car wash with friendly-spirited engagement and integrity. What do we want? We seek a dedicated individual that is looking to advance their leadership opportunity. This individual must possess a high drive to win while maintaining the integrity to do the right thing. A successful candidate would love working outdoors in all conditions and will be excited to roll up their sleeves to get the job done! You will manage a team of highly trained, optimistic Advisors, Operators, and Attendants to provide exceptional guest service in a fun, interactive atmosphere. We need an enthusiastic leader that has experience in management, and a willingness to learn the car wash industry. Location: Russell Speeders Car Wash 527 N Bedford Rd, Bedford Hills, NY 10507 (Westchester County)

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:a0c169a0-ab7.description: We are looking for experienced language professionals to support an ongoing project focused on reviewing and refining Czech (Czech Republic) Translation Quality Rater customer service content. This role involves improving machine-translated materials to ensure accuracy, natural language, and alignment with project guidelines. What you’ll do Edit and review machine-translated customer service content with a high level of accuracy and consistency. Evaluate MT output quality and apply severity ratings when required, following project guidelines. Produce high-quality human translations as reference data for model training and quality evaluation. Follow provided style guides, tone rules, and terminology requirements. Identify and report recurring MT quality issues and batch-level trends. Project details Language: Czech (Czech Republic) Content type: Customer service content (general) Project duration: OngoingThis role involves intermittent work, with tasks assigned on an ad hoc basis throughout the year depending on client needs. Volumes and timing may vary. Hourly rate: $15
